results.title: The prompt table shows the columns Prompt, Category, Type, Market and Actions

steps.title: Given the user has generated prompts
steps.expected: The Prompts step is displayed

steps.title: When the table renders
steps.expected: All prompts of all markets are in one table, with no market or type tabs

steps.title: Then the table shows its five columns
steps.expected: "Prompt", "Category", "Type", "Market", "Actions"

results.notes: Session A: Decathlon (decathlon.com), markets United Kingdom - English (EN) + France - French (FR), AI Insights English (EN). Discovery (about 2 s) returned "Sporting Goods" (C1) and "Outdoor Gear" (C2), nothing removed. Generate Prompts (about 5 s): 140 rows, ring "710 / 1000 prompts · 140 selected". One single table (1 <table>, no role=tab / tablist element), rows of both markets GB (EN) and FR (FR) in it. Header cells: keep column (select-all checkbox "Tick or untick every prompt", wizard.promptTable.ariaSelectAll, plus the Show prompts menu, no text label), then "Prompt", "Category", "Type", "Market", "Actions" (textContent; rendered in upper case by CSS text-transform: PROMPT, CATEGORY, TYPE, MARKET, ACTIONS).

steps.expected: A menu opens with "Sort ascending", "Sort descending", a checkbox list and "Clear filter"

When the user checks C1 and chooses Sort ascending
steps.expected: Only C1 prompts are listed and the header shows the number 2 (1 value + 1 sort)

steps.expected: All prompts are listed again, the sort is removed and the header shows no number

results.notes: Same session, no filter. Category header has the trigger "Sort and filter Category" (data-testid wizard-prompt-col-menu-category). Menu: "Sort ascending", "Sort descending" (menuitemradio), checkbox list (menuitemcheckbox), "Clear filter" (wizard.promptTable.sortAscending / clearFilter). Checkbox list observed: Sporting Goods 60, Outdoor Gear 60, Other 0, Overview 20. The CSV expects C1 (60), C2 (60), Overview (20): the three expected values and counts match, but an extra value "Other" (0) is listed (wizard.promptTable.categoryOther, value id OTHER_CATEGORY), flag ON behaviour (GEO-1247), so PARTIAL: QA decision needed. C1 ticked + Sort ascending: 60 rows, all Sporting Goods, header reads "CATEGORY 2". Clear filter: 140 rows, first rows back to the original order (Overview / Brand Image GB (EN) first, so the sort is removed), header "CATEGORY" with no number, Sort ascending unchecked on reopen.

Type Sort ascending: rows ordered Visibility (40), Reputation (40), Competitive (40), Brand Image (20); header "TYPE 1". Market menu: GB (EN) 70, FR (FR) 70. Market Sort ascending: all FR (FR) rows (70) then all GB (EN) rows (70); header "MARKET 1", Type header back to "TYPE" with no number and Type Sort ascending unchecked (one sort at a time). Category = Outdoor Gear (C2) ticked: 60 rows; Type menu: Visibility 20, Reputation 20, Competitive 20, Brand Image 0, Other 0 (Brand Image stays listed with 0). Extra value "Other 0" also listed (flag ON, wizard.promptTable.typeOther). Filters cleared afterwards.

results.notes: Session B (minimal scope): Decathlon, 1 market United Kingdom - English (EN); discovery returned Sporting Goods + Outdoor Gear, Outdoor Gear removed (dialog Remove). Generate Prompts: 40 rows (10 Brand Image Overview, 10 Visibility, 10 Competitive, 10 Reputation for Sporting Goods, GB (EN)), ring "610 / 1000 prompts · 40 selected". 40 trash clicks (no confirm dialog; toast "Prompt deleted." + Undo, wizard.common.questionDeleted). Empty table: 0 rows, header row still displayed with its 4 filter triggers enabled (Show prompts, Category, Type, Market; Category menu lists Sporting Goods 0, Other 0, Overview 0); ring "570 / 1000 prompts · 0 selected" still displayed. Empty-state card data-testid wizard-prompt-empty: "No prompts yet" (wizard.promptTable.emptyTitle) / "Add your first prompt, or adjust the filters above. Suggested prompts appear at the end of the table when there are any." (wizard.promptTable.emptyBody) with its own "Add prompt" button (wizard-prompt-empty-add-btn); the toolbar Add prompt stays too. Review & Launch disabled. Add prompt in the card: the editable new row opens (wizard-prompt-draft-row, text input focused, Category, Type, Market selects, confirm and Cancel), card gone. Draft cancelled, wizard exited with Exit and Discard.

steps.expected: The rows move under the pinned header; the footer stays fixed

results.notes: Session A, 140 rows. Scroll container data-testid wizard-layout-content (top 113 px, padding-top 28 px). scrollTop 0: tracker line ("710 / 1000 prompts · 140 selected" + Add prompt, sticky top-0) at 183 px, header at 232 px. From scrollTop 100 to the end (6368): tracker line stays at 141 px, column header at 189 px, footer (Back / Review & Launch) fixed at 672 px; only the rows move (first visible row index 1 to 131), last row reached. Side finding (visual, already seen on GEO-1233): the 28 px gap between the container top and the pinned tracker line lets scrolled rows show above the tracker line (see step3_then).

results.notes: Session A. V = "Top Sporting Goods?" - Sporting Goods - Visibility - GB (EN). On hover: Category and Type become comboboxes (aria-label "Category" / "Type"); the Market cell has no control (plain text GB (EN)). Type options on an existing row: Visibility, Reputation, Competitive, Brand Image (no "Other" option, unlike the Add prompt draft row). Type = Brand Image: category becomes "Overview", category select disabled. Type back to Visibility: category shows the placeholder "Category" and its select opens by itself (Sporting Goods, Outdoor Gear); Sporting Goods picked: row reads Sporting Goods - Visibility, still ticked. Competitive prompt "Best for Sporting Goods: Decathlon, [Competitor 1], [Competitor 2] or [Competitor 3]?": Type select opens, Visibility picked: refused, inline alert "Remove the competitor placeholders first." (wizard.promptTable.competitorPlaceholders, role=alert), type stays Competitive.
